summary: This directory acts as the root architectural layer for a TypeScript-based application, unifying core feature logic, design system components, and cross-cutting utility functions. It ensures modularity by isolating business rules from UI implementation and infrastructure concerns.
responsibilities: Coordinate core business workflows and domain state management
Provide a unified entry point for the design system and UI components
Encapsulate cross-cutting utility logic for CSS and styling
Decouple domain-specific logic from infrastructure dependencies
Expose application-wide interfaces for feature consumption
relationships: The application core delegates domain-specific logic to the features directory while utilizing the ui directory for consistent component rendering.
Utility functions in the lib directory support component development by resolving stylistic conflicts.
The root index facilitates access to the design system, allowing consistent consumption of UI components and orchestration logic.
designDecisions: Barrel file patterns for simplified module consumption
Separation of concerns between business logic and UI presentation
Adapter-based approach to insulate the application from specific third-party library dependencies
Centralization of stylistic and structural utilities
